notes.title: Exclusive DLC for Wishlisting Video World's successor, 'A Halloween Valentine'!
notes.notes:
[url=https://woorise.com/ahalloweenvalentine/halloween-bonus-skin][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38964236/6e375a5ed89348b9de3f8354a65302483e23b37e.png[/img][/url]

What a better to celebrate Halloween than announcing my new game [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2107800/A_Halloween_Valentine/]A HALLOWEEN VALENTINE[/url][/i] - a puzzle adventure pop album set in a haunted amusement park on Valentine's day. Solve logic puzzles while bopping along to original songs with lyrics to find the way back to the love of your life!

[h3]FEATURES[/h3]
[list]
[*] A myriad of logic puzzles akin to those in Zelda games
[*] 10-track pop album soundtrack by Monster Mansion
[*] A spooky amount of puns!
[*] An adorable and charming 3D art style
[*] Comedic dialogue and characters
[*] A queer love story
[*] Up to 3 hours of playtime
[/list]

To say thank you to our early supporters, we are giving away a DLC skin for the main character Casper. To get the skin, click the banner below and follow the instructions to wishlist the game and listen to the soundtrack on Spotify. You'll then be a confirmed spook-sweetheart and be LOCKED IN to get that skin on day one.

[url=https://woorise.com/ahalloweenvalentine/halloween-bonus-skin][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38964236/15f22486d425dd22f87b13e45ddc3259b9683691.png[/img][/url]

[h3]A SUCCESSOR TO VIDEO WORLD[/h3]

[i]A Halloween Valentine[/i] is a spiritual successor to Video World - it's set in the same world and has some of the same characters (yes, including our favourite punny pumpkin Jill O' Lantern!), but stands on it's own in terms of narrative and mechanics.

It includes a 10-track album of new songs which I'm DYING to release (pun absolutely intended), including collaborations with K-Pop writer Alina Smith (Itzy, Red Velvet, Chung-Ha) and one of my favourite artists - Myylo!

The game is currently in development for PC and Nintendo Switch.

notes.title: Video World Soundtrack - Production Deep-Dive
notes.notes:
Join me live as I take you through the ins and outs of producing the music for Video World! I will be opening up my original music production sessions and take you on a deep-dive into the synths, sounds, vocals, effects/plugins, and creative process of how the songs from Video World were created.

This will be a fun, informative stream suitable for songwriters/composers/music producers who want some tips from the pop-music production world and an insight into my personal tools/style/processes.

The chat will be open and questions will be very welcomed - please come a long and have some fun with me!
